verses.1: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD Who stand in the house of the LORD through the long hours of night.
verses.2: Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
verses.3: May the LORD who made heaven and earth bless you from Zion.

notes.text: Servants of the LORD: priests and Levites. Cf Deut 10:8; Psalm 113:1; 135:1; Azariah 1:62-63.
